events.summary: Lluwen captures Kirol and brings them before Morcant.
events.quote: Lluwen brought the student, Kirol , before Morcant.

events.summary: Morcant learns the students awoke Isilu by mistake and begins to plot.
Morcant plans to poison Isilu with dawnglove and conscripts Kirol to pick it.
events.quote: she conscripted Kirol to do it for her, since they had no dual nature
they were interrupted by Ajani Goldmane

events.summary: Kirol, Sanar and Lluwen steal the dawnglow from Morcant, transforming her into her Shadowmoor aspect.
events.quote: stole the dawnglow from her, transforming her into her Shadowmoor aspect in the process

relations.quote: the current ruler of the Gilt-Leaf elves
